ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels dominate approximately 90% of the visible fluke surface, contrasted by a low-intensity (black) perimeter along the trailing edge and lateral tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid high-intensity white field across both lobes; a continuous thin low-intensity black band follows the trailing edge; two isolated low-intensity circular spots are visible at approximate normalized coordinates [0.48, 0.55] and [0.22, 0.45].

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a vertex angle of approximately 75-85 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations forming a sawtooth pattern along the entire trailing edge from the median notch to the lateral tips, isolated from the high-contrast water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve on both lobes; displaying concave curvature at the medial section near the notch transitioning to convex curvature towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized clusters of heterogeneous, textured, yellowish-brown nodes (barnacles) are present at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle colonization on the lateral tips of both fluke lobes.
